why_it_didnt_work: Lost to a near-identical variant (EW1) whose only real difference was a HIGHER-LEVEL mechanism. This one's differentiator is specific/throughput ('hundreds of top-performing assets a month'), which on cold email gives the buyer less to project onto and can read as content-farm volume / more-work-for-me / too-good-to-be-true. EW1's abstract 'a mix of creator, UGC & customer-generated content at scale that turned them into a household brand' let the reader fill in their own win, and its aspirational outcome ('household brand') added a pull this variant has no equivalent for. Provisional channel lesson: specific mechanisms tend to underperform on COLD EMAIL vs SMS (opposite of the SMS pattern). Caveat: n~505/arm, 0 vs a handful is within noise - re-test before treating as law. Full record: clients/kynship/output/2026-07-29-Kynship-email-AB-loss.md [redline]
